results.label: a retained-stop payload the app cannot parse is reported unavailable with its reason, not as "no stops"
the rest of that surface still answers: one unreadable field does not blank the channel
the unreadable row is left byte-for-byte as it was: not repaired, not reset, not deleted
settings the app cannot parse are reported unavailable, and the channel does not invent an empty checklist
the malformed settings row is untouched by the question
a practice row with an unreadable measured time is reported and excluded from both the count and the seconds
that unreadable row is left exactly as stored — the channel does not round it, repair it or drop it
markup is refused at the bound and everything else is treated as one plain question
an injection-shaped question neither executes nor corrupts: the schema is intact and the channel answered with data it owns
every hostile question is echoed back exactly as typed (no evaluation, no interpolation, no rewriting)
280 characters is accepted and 281 is refused as ask_invalid/400
a question made only of whitespace is refused rather than answered as the empty string
no statement in the module is built by concatenating anything, let alone the question
no answer leaks a filesystem path, a SQLite message or a stack frame
a battery over corrupted rows and hostile questions leaves every table byte-identical
after the whole battery the corrupted rows are still exactly as corrupt: the channel repaired nothing anywhere
the channel still answers normally after all of that, with the same honest unavailable line

scope: M109 hardening and no-repair proof: actual runtime/auth/SQL/DOM on literal journals, fixedUTC; deterministic read-only advisory channel, no model/network/provider/broker/mental-state/pixel/production proof
